implemented: Source expiry is swept before busy/foreground gates, on restart/retry, and at prepared-write/admission boundaries. Active expired extraction is cancelled without waiting for provider cooperation.

Durable current state, policy revision and expiry are checked before provider generation and after content/scope callbacks immediately before synchronous memory admission. Prepared writes have their own current-state/expiry SQL predicate.

Unexpired prepared work survives foreground preemption; admitted memory is not deleted by source-work expiry. A throwing post-admission observer cannot resurrect saved work.
